title: вот
reviewer: Codex R33 local semantic source review

semanticReview.method: Inspección directa de fuente académica/institucional y pasaje localizado; artículo acotado; APA 7, Evidence y assessEntry posterior ejecutados.
findings: The Gramota.ru metaslovарь lists pointing and focusing/intensifying uses of вот, including reference to something presented as immediately available; the article is restricted to those dictionary meanings and removes unsupported claims about frequency and closure.
Localizador: Metaslovарь entry ‘вот’, meanings 1–3: points to a person/thing or event in immediate proximity or narrated as present; can intensify/clarify a following word or whole utterance.
APA 7: Грамота.ру. (s. f.). Вот: значение и употребление. https://gramota.ru/meta/vot
limitations: Se eliminaron afirmaciones de frecuencia, registro o significado fuera del alcance verificado.
Se conservaron los enlaces de entradas relacionadas originales.
